title: Section Reader Typesets STEM and Dollar-Delimited Math
description: The frontend module shall typeset both AsciiDoc STEM and dollar-delimited math in the section reader.
rationale: Stored sections written before the STEM convention contain dollar-delimited math; sections generated after the convention use STEM. The reader must handle both forms so that all existing and future course content renders as typeset glyphs rather than raw source text.
